title: Electrical
headline:
Outlets, panels, lighting,
and EV chargers.
shortDescription: Outlets, switches, ceiling fans, lighting, sub-panels, full panel upgrades, and Level 2 EV charger installs — all done by our licensed electrician with permits pulled where required.
lead: We run a full residential electrical service inside the company. Our licensed electrician (KS electrical contractor license #E-19842) leads every electrical job and signs off on the work before the crew leaves. Small jobs are flat-rate — outlet adds, ceiling fans, simple light installs — so you know the price before we start. Larger work like panel upgrades and EV chargers is quoted on-site after a free walkthrough, with permits pulled and inspected through the city or county where required.

sections.heading: Common electrical jobs
sections.intro: A representative list — small jobs are flat-rate; bigger work is quoted on-site.

items.label: Outlets and switches
items.body: Add, replace, or relocate outlets and switches. GFCI and AFCI swaps for kitchen, bath, and bedroom code compliance. Flat-rate $185 for a standard outlet add on existing circuit

items.label: Ceiling fans and fixtures
items.body: Ceiling fan installs, light fixture swaps, recessed can lighting, and under-cabinet lighting. Flat-rate $295 for a standard fan install on existing fixture box

items.label: Panel work
items.body: Full panel replacements, sub-panels for additions or finished basements, breaker swaps, and load-balancing for high-draw appliances. Permitted and inspected

items.label: EV charger installs
items.body: Level 2 EV charger installations — most homes need a 240V circuit pulled from the panel to the garage or driveway. Free on-site quote; typical install ranges $750–$1,800 depending on panel distance and load

items.label: Generator and transfer switches
items.body: Manual transfer switch installs for portable generators; whole-home generator coordination with our partner installer

items.label: Code corrections and inspections
items.body: Buyer's-inspection electrical fixes, knob-and-tube assessments, and aluminum wiring remediation in older KC-area homes

sections.heading: How an electrical job goes
sections.body: Small jobs are flat-rate; bigger work follows the same arc.
items: Phone call or web request — describe what you need, send photos of the panel and the location if you can
Flat-rate quote on the phone for standard outlets, fans, and small lighting work
Free on-site walkthrough for panel work, EV chargers, or anything that needs a permit
Licensed electrician on every job, written quote before work starts, permits pulled and inspections coordinated
